$comment: The game's invented companies, apps, robot models, stations, perks and the accelerator: one place for their display names, so the UI, barks and billboards all spell them the same way. Every name here is a registered name field for the content lint and must be in content/cleared-names.json. Ids are stable; display names may change after the user signs the name search off.

brands.name: Moat Labs
brands.note: The antagonist. Graphite and teal; a castle-and-moat logo (invented).

brands.name: Meander
brands.note: The robotaxi company; most of the traffic. Scenic routes.

brands.name: Trundle
brands.note: Maker of the Trundle sidewalk delivery robot.

brands.name: Footman
brands.note: Tall, slim errand robot with a lantern-shaped head; carries shopping. Displayed as Footman (plural Footmen).

brands.name: Trundle
brands.note: Four-wheeled sidewalk delivery robot with a roll-top lid.

brands.name: Bot Check
brands.note: The scanner app. Confident, sometimes wrong.

brands.name: Humbled
brands.note: The thought-leader feed (renamed after the name search; see content/cleared-names.json).

brands.name: FogCast
brands.note: The weather app. Never below 95% confidence; right half the time.

brands.name: Dry Powder
brands.note: Talk radio; market corrections called like sport.

brands.name: Marine Layer
brands.note: Fog perk; also mission 9's title. Never used on clothing, a shop or a cosmetic.

brands.name: Ramen
brands.note: The parody accelerator; its partners are archetypes.

provenance.review: Pending: a second agent session reads every line against the docs/ai-layer.md checklist; the user reviews a stratified sample.
